addi    t2, t2, handler - .         # t2 = address of handler
csrw    mtvec, t2

# Transfer to U-mode
call    machine_to_user

# -------- U-mode code --------
csrr    t0, seed                    # Access seed CSR (should trap)

# -------- M-mode trap handler --------
handler:
    csrr    t1, mcause               # Read exception cause
    lui     t2, 0x80002               # t2 = 0x80002000 (upper 20 bits)
    sd      t1, 0(t2)                # Store cause to memory

    # Set mepc to continue at label "done"
    auipc   t3, 0
    addi    t3, t3, done - .         # t3 = address of done
    csrw    mepc, t3
    mret

# -------- Continue after handling --------
done:
    lui     t2, 0x80002               # t2 = 0x80002000
    ld      s0, 0(t2)                # Load stored mcause into s0

# Result: s0 = 2

    li t0, 0x1

    csrw pmpcfg0, t1

    li t2, 0x80000000

    # Install exception handler
    la t3, handler
    csrw mtvec, t3

    # Attempt a load from the protected region (should trap)
    li a1, 0x80000000
    lw a0, 0(a1)           # access exception expected here

    # Skip over the load after handling (won’t be reached if trap works)
    j done

handler:
    # Capture the exception cause
    csrr a0, mcause        # a0 will hold the exception code (expected 5 for load access fault)
    # Advance mepc to skip the faulting instruction
    csrr t4, mepc
    addi t4, t4, 4
    csrw mepc, t4
    mret

done:
    nop

+ <value> must be hexadecimal or decimal.
+ The only allowed multi-condition "# Result:" form is two "!=" checks on the same target connected with "&&".
+ When using "&&", both sides MUST use the same target and both operators MUST be "!=".
